articles.title: Distinguished Programs Adds Marine Cargo Program Led by Industry Veteran Ralph Salce
articles.mainIdea: Distinguished Programs Adds Marine Cargo Program Led by Industry Veteran Ralph Salce
articles.summary: Business Wire: Distinguished Programs Adds Marine Cargo Program Led by Industry Veteran Ralph Salce. NEW YORK, January 26, 2026--Distinguished Programs ("Distinguished"), a national insurance program manager and MGA, has added a new Marine Cargo program led by industry veteran Ralph Salce. The program will provide comprehensive marine cargo solutions, including available coverage for global transit exposures, stock throughput, and specialized logistics risks. Underwriting is expected to begin in the first half of 2026.
